concerns.text: The plan computes clustering descriptors *after* impurities are inserted into the grain‑boundary interface (see Phase 2‑4). This measures the post‑segregation state rather than the pre‑existing bulk impurity clustering the research question seeks to evaluate, conflating predictor and outcome and breaking causal validity.

The validation step records `[DATA_UNAVAILABLE]` when no DFT benchmark exists, yet the study proceeds to draw conclusions about the relationship between clustering and segregation. Without external validation, the findings are limited to the EAM model and cannot support the intended scientific claim, undermining external validity.
